title: AQRA — Air Quality Monitoring
description: Air-quality monitoring for North Macedonia, built as two deployed services. A Flask REST API trains and serves machine-learning models that forecast pollutant levels from weather and sensor readings, documented with Swagger and backed by MongoDB. A Vue 3 single-page app renders those readings as a Leaflet pollutant heatmap with a 24-hour time slider and Chart.js history, and also ships as a Capacitor mobile app. Both run as containers on Kubernetes behind Nginx.

title: Crypto Prophet
description: A FastAPI service that trains machine-learning models to forecast cryptocurrency prices, exposing predictions through a documented REST API. Packaged with Docker for reproducible deployments.

title: Task Manager
description: A full-stack task-management app: a Spring Boot REST API with secured authentication and MongoDB persistence, paired with a Vue.js frontend for registering, logging in and managing tasks.
